transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Thank you. Well, what finally brought me in is... I feel like the part of me that used to reach out for people and actually take pleasure in things has just gone very quiet. 

I used to really enjoy my work, doing yoga, going to galleries, or even just journaling. But lately... I don't know, the drive for all of that is just gone. I'm mostly just moving through my daily obligations right now, just going through the motions.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It's been about eight months. This whole shift... just how I'm thinking, working, and connecting with people, it really started right around the time we took an older relative into our apartment.
Before these past eight months, have you ever experienced a period where you felt down or lost interest in things like this?

No, I haven't. I mean, I've had normal ups and downs, but nothing like this. Never a stretch of time where I just felt this... blank, or disconnected from the things I usually love. This is really the first time I've ever experienced anything quite like this.
Alongside losing interest in things, have you also been feeling sad, down, or low most of the day?

Not really, no. I wouldn't say I feel sad or down. It's not like I'm walking around crying or feeling depressed... it's just more of a blankness. I just don't feel much of anything at all, rather than feeling sad.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns over these past eight months?

No, my sleep has been pretty normal, actually. I haven't noticed any changes there. I go to bed around the same time and wake up around the same time. It's just... everything else that feels different. But sleep hasn't been an issue.
How have your energy levels been over these past few months?

My energy levels? Um... I guess they've been fine. I haven't really noticed feeling more tired or anything like that. I still have the energy to do things, I just... I just don't really want to do them. But physically, my energy feels normal.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight over these past eight months?
No, my appetite has been pretty steady. I haven't noticed any weight changes either. I still eat normally, so... no, nothing really different there.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or feeling like you would be better off not being here?

No, no thoughts like that. I haven't felt like I'd be better off dead or anything. I mean, I know I've been feeling... well, just not wanting to do much of anything lately, but I definitely don't want to hurt myself. So, no, nothing along those lines.
Have you been experiencing feelings of anxiety, nervousness, or excessive worry during this time?

No, I haven't really been feeling anxious or nervous. I don't think I've been worrying about things excessively, either. It's... it's mostly just that lack of interest I mentioned earlier, but I'm not sitting around feeling on edge or anything like that. So, no anxiety.
